fixes.description: Mathlib now has `QuadraticAlgebra.mk_zero_eq_C` and `QuadraticAlgebra.C_eq_algebraMap` as simp lemmas; inside `simp` they rewrite the literal `⟨2, 0⟩` in the type parameter of `Biquad d` (and `⟨x, 0⟩` terms) to `algebraMap`, so `re_add`/`re_mul` no longer match and 18 `ext <;> simp` / `simp` proofs failed. One added line `attribute [-simp] QuadraticAlgebra.mk_zero_eq_C QuadraticAlgebra.C_eq_algebraMap` in each of the two `WeightedTorusJets.W11` blocks (the erasure is scoped to its namespace block); no proof changed.

`private theorem exists_dyadic_bound` is used in the body of the exposed public def `dyadicShellIndex`; a private declaration cannot appear in an exposed body, so `private` was removed (same as the earlier port).

`IsLocalization.AtPrime.equivQuotMaximalIdeal` is now an `AlgEquiv` (`≃ₐ[R]`); `.symm.trans` then expects an `AlgEquiv`, so `identityResidueEquiv` (a `RingEquiv`) uses `.symm.toRingEquiv.trans`; the two dependent errors in `identityResidueEquiv_base` disappear; statements unchanged.
added `public import Mathlib.RingTheory.Ideal.KrullsHeightTheorem`: `ringKrullDim_le_spanFinrank_maximalIdeal` is only reachable through a non-public Mathlib import chain.
added `public import Mathlib.Algebra.Module.SpanRankOperations`: `IsLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_eq_finrank_cotangentSpace` is only reachable through a non-public Mathlib import chain.

In `projectiveResolutionOfExact`, `ShortComplex.quasiIso_iff_of_zeros'` first side goal: `simp` now closes it by itself, so the trailing `rfl` failed with "no goals"; `(by simp; rfl)` became `(by simp)` for that one argument (the same drift as the progressions port's BCHLatticeImageGap).

Same drift as FieldAutomorphisms: the new simp lemmas `QuadraticAlgebra.mk_zero_eq_C` and `QuadraticAlgebra.C_eq_algebraMap` rewrite the `⟨2, 0⟩` in the type of `Biquad d` inside `simp`; one added line `attribute [-simp] QuadraticAlgebra.mk_zero_eq_C QuadraticAlgebra.C_eq_algebraMap` in each of the namespace blocks `W10` and `WeightedTorusJets.W11` (the erasure is scoped to its block); no proof changed.
